sections.text_helper: Section 43.7.2 "LTDC back porch configuration register (LTDC_BPCR)" in chapter 43 (LCD-TFT display controller (LTDC)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 2118.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x00C
Reset value: 0x00000000
This register defines the accumulated number of horizontal synchronization and back porch
pixels minus 1 (HSYNCwidth+HBP-1), and the accumulated number of vertical
synchronization and back porch lines minus 1 (VSYNCheight+VBP-1).
RefertoFigure448 and Section43.4 for a configuration example.
Bits 31:28 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 27:16 AHBP[11:0]: Accumulated horizontal back porch (in units of pixel clock period)
This bitfield defines the accumulated horizontal back porch width that includes the horizontal
synchronization and horizontal back porch pixels minus 1.
The horizontal back porch is the period between horizontal synchronization going inactive,
and the start of the active display part of the next scan line.
Bits 15:12 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 11:0 AVBP[11:0]: Accumulated Vertical back porch (in units of horizontal scan line)
This bitfield defines the accumulated vertical back porch width that includes the vertical
synchronization and vertical back porch lines minus 1.
The vertical back porch is the number of horizontal scan lines at a start of frame to the start of
the first active scan line of the next frame.
